name: Panettone
origin: A tall, domed Milanese enriched sweet bread traditionally made with a natural sourdough starter (lievito madre) over a multi-day process, studded with candied citrus peel and raisins, and eaten at Christmas across Italy.

ingredients.note: many recipes weight this heavily toward yolks specifically; modelled here as whole-egg-equivalent mass

modelled as a nominal commercial-yeast-equivalent dose; the real lievito madre (natural starter) process is a multi-day pre-ferment this bakersPercent figure does not capture — see the same caveat in stollen.json

process.name: build and mix dough
process.description: mix flour, milk, sugar, egg and starter/yeast, then knead in softened butter in stages

process.name: fold in fruit and peel
process.description: fold in raisins and candied citrus peel

process.name: long proof
process.description: proof at length, the real natural-starter process taking many hours to a full day

process.name: bake
process.description: bake in a tall paper mould

notes: A representative panettone proportion (butter and egg both substantial relative to flour, moderate sugar, a large dried-fruit and candied-peel load) drawn from the pattern shared across published Italian panettone formulas. See the leavening-role note for why this formulation engine's chemical-leavening figure is only a rough proxy for a natural-starter yeasted dough, not literal bicarbonate mass.
